construct: Attrition bias is a selection bias that arises when losses to follow-up differ systematically between comparison groups or are related to prognosis/outcome, so the participants remaining for analysis are no longer comparable to those originally enrolled.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: In a randomized trial, differential dropout that is related to poor response and a complete-case analysis changes the composition of the comparison groups; this is attrition bias.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Recall, lead-time, verification, and immortal-time biases have distinct mechanisms. The defining feature here is systematic outcome-related loss to follow-up between randomized groups, which is attrition bias.
